description: This file contains shell script functions for managing firmware upgrades on GL.iNet devices, including setting up boot partitions, handling NAND and NOR upgrades, and selecting boot devices based on environment variables.

methods.name: glinet_using_boot_dev_switch
methods.description: Checks if the device's boot device switch is turned on.

methods.name: glinet_set_next_boot_nand
methods.description: Prepares the device to boot from NAND on next reboot.

methods.name: glinet_set_next_boot_nor
methods.description: Prepares the device to boot from NOR on next reboot.

methods.name: glinet_nand_nor_do_upgrade
methods.description: Determines whether to do a NAND or NOR upgrade and invokes the corresponding functions.

methods.name: nand_nor_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade handler that chooses between NAND and NOR upgrade modes based on the magic number of the upgrade file.
